basic_info.description:
Sleek Historic Condo Downtown

At once modern and sleek, the Montgomery hearkens back to a more elegant era. One of SOMA's most coveted boutique conversion developments, the Montgomery is a historic and architectural gem gracefully nestled on a small side street across from the Palace Hotel.

Unit Features:

 Studio, 1 bathroom 
 489 sq. ft. per owner 
 Spacious and open living/dining room 
 Kitchen features glossy white lacquered cabinetry, black granite countertops, stainless Bosch appliances and gas stovetop, Fisher Paykel refrigerator
 Hardwood floors in living areas
 Bosch washer and dryer in oversize laundry/cleaning closet
 Spacious bathroom with stone vanity, limestone flooring, and Kohler soaking bathtub

Designed by the Reid Brothers architects in 1914 on a site specially selected for the central location, 74 New Montgomery served as the headquarters of a newspaper, The San Francisco Call. The building served as prime office space until a 2005 seismic retrofit and extensive interior design conversion into just 107 highly sought-after luxury residential units poised in an intimate historic setting and offering first-class amenities.

The Montgomery Highlights

 107-unit boutique historic building
 24-hour controlled access and attended lobby
 On-site building management
 Concierge
 Panoramic landscaped roof deck with barbecue grill
 Lounge area with wireless internet
 Adjacent to the Palace Hotel
 Rotating art displays

Neighborhood Highlights

 Half-block from Market Street and Montgomery Street and the Montgomery BART station
 Half-block to Yerba Buena Gardens and Yerba Buena Center for the Arts
 Close to Union Square and the Embarcadero
 A few blocks away from Union Square/Financial District, Target, Westfield Shopping Center, Whole Foods, the Ferry Building Farmers Market, the Museum District
 Spectacular dining options at all price points, ranging from MY China to RN74
 Located in Yerba Buena between SOMA and South Beach, just south of the Financial District and downtown

* Square footage and other information was received from third party sources. Such information has not been, and will not be, verified by Mavericks Realty Management. If important to buyers or renters, this information must be verified by independent investigation.
